speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: MCI's mission is to connect people to community, Government and opportunity.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The infocomm and media sectors are converging due to rapid technological advancements.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The Government Chief Information Office functions within IDA will be restructured as an independent entity – the Government Technology Organisation (GTO).

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: GTO will focus on building engineering talent for the Government and support its digital transformation efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: This will help the Government deliver world-class digital services to Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: As a unified authority, IMDA will be able to enact competition and consumer protection regulations in a more holistic and progressive manner.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The freed-up spectrum will provide more capacity for mobile broadband and better support our Smart Nation development.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: In the future economy, design will become an increasingly important enabler.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Through design, enterprises can be more responsive to customers' needs and innovative in their product and service offerings.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will launch Design 2025, a long-term plan to make Singapore a hub for design, build up the design sector and encourage the adoption of design to transform our economy and society.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The growth of the infocomm, media and design sectors and their adoption by the rest of the economy, will create good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will help Singaporeans acquire the skills that will be increasingly important in the future: computational thinking, coding, design thinking and story-telling.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will expand existing initiatives to equip our young with the skillsets needed to thrive in the future.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Through SkillsFuture, we will support the development of manpower for the infocomm, media and design sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will continue to support start-ups and entrepreneurship in the infocomm, media and design sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: To encourage innovation through experimenting, tinkering and risk-taking, we will set up more prototyping laboratories, provide greater access to networking opportunities and co-locate mutually-supporting expertise and services.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will roll out the Smart Nation Platform, a network infrastructure of sensors to enable us to build a Smart Nation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The platform will support sensor-based services and smart system solutions 	Page: 21 and facilitate greater sharing of data to improve Government operations and the delivery of public services.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: At the same time, we will release more public sector data to encourage private sector development of applications that can improve our quality of life.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will leave no one behind in Singapore's Smart Nation journey.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will continue to ensure that low-income families and senior citizens have access to the broadband Internet and enjoy the benefits of Internet connectivity.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: While the Smart Nation opens up many opportunities, we must also ensure that it is built upon a secure, robust and resilient infrastructure.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will develop a national cyber security strategy to strengthen Singapore's information infrastructure.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Priority will be given to our critical sectors of energy, water, transport, health, Government, infocomm, media, security and emergency services and banking and finance.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will introduce a Cyber Security Bill that will give the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore greater powers to secure our critical information infrastructure.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will develop the cybersecurity ecosystem in Singapore and grow cybersecurity talent and manpower.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will also seek international cooperation on cybersecurity to overcome the transnational nature of cyber threats and work with the private sector to raise public awareness of the importance of cybersecurity.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will make Singapore's history and archival heritage more accessible to Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Learning from the success of our Singapore Memory Project and Citizen Archivists experiences, we will continue to collaborate with our citizens to promote Singaporeans' appreciation and understanding of our history and heritage.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Together with the people and private sectors, we will curate our archived materials better and co-create presentations from our National Library collections for wider public access.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: As a start, we will develop a Constitutional Gallery, to be housed in the National Gallery Singapore, to showcase key constitutional documents of our nation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will transform our public libraries to support Singaporeans' lifelong learning.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Our public libraries will cater to different reading and learning preferences.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will offer differentiated collections, interactive technology and conducive library spaces to make learning more engaging and interesting.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will partner the National Library Board's network of volunteers and supporters to promote this reading movement.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will promote information, media and cyber literacy in a concerted way.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Page: 22 We will continue to engage Singaporeans on Government policies, especially in the digital space and on social media.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Through regular dialogues and surveys, we aim to better understand our people's concerns and aspirations so as to develop policies and programmes that will improve their quality of life.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will also improve our capabilities in whole-of-Government crisis communications.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: MCI's strategic priorities and plans aim to build an Engaged and Connected Singapore in close partnership with our people and private sectors, in order that we may provide a good quality of life for all Singaporeans.
